**Pulse hint — passes.** `src/style.css:1137` adds a compact dark backing, padding and10px type only when `#pulse-summary` is nonempty. Existing text, controls and simulation are unchanged. The actual bright console and dark water views show a readable hint without overlap; the selector avoids an empty-element patch. These comparisons temporarily reveal a paused HUD and stage the old CSS on the final build; they are appearance evidence, not gameplay. CSS viewports are1920×1080 and1280×800, DPR2, Light; the1080 captures are downsampled1280×720 PNGs, not native1080 screenshots. Adjacent guidance remains the separate P3 below.

**A, healthy zero power — passes.** This is an ordinary-control continuation imported from an earned current-route export, not seeded zero or fresh New preparation. After the recorded supported preflight service, actual boosted movement exhausts the battery over534.9 simulation seconds. At actual zero, `dart_17` has health100, `disabled:false`, zero charge and the player still aboard. Safe exit and empty reboarding refusal preserve state; local cargo take/return works. The local reserve uses the same `item_10`,100→0, giving35 hull power without healing or resetting emergency air. Unsupported service refuses. Return and actual reload match44 elapsed ticks; the real0.584375 hull damage on return is retained. This establishes the healthy-empty branch separately from disablement.

**B, fresh warning without eligible charge — passes.** The imported earned hunter state is allowed to reset naturally: idle tick33043, new warning33116, G refusal33122, quiet disengagement33388, then safe return. The carried cell stays0 and the full workshop cell stays remote at100; no pulse or recharge funds the response. The live run139 notice establishes the G refusal. Current command execution is atomic and the captured refusal endpoint equals exactly six ordinary no-input ticks. Actual return/reload matches47 ticks. This closes the earlier already-disengaging evidence gap.

**C, current installed-trim recovery — passes.** Actual terrain collisions disable the earned Dart at about70m with `item_20` still installed; safe exit uses the150m suit. Local Bobbin/tow and a paid patch preserve `dart_17`, `dart_17_hold`, cargo and module identities. The loss stays through tow and clears only on recovery. Patch spends2 bound alloy and1 membrane, restores hull65, increments `boundRepairs` to1, and does not debit a reserve cell or duplicate the module. Current replay verifies the physical tow and occupied-operation protections. Actual recovered quiet speed4.1994985m/s confirms the trim remains useful; return/reload matches29 ticks. **C contains no player incapacity** (`failures:0`); its tow/patch rescue count is not substituted for the separate repeated player-failure evidence.
